answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the Proof of Agent economy binds identity verification to verifiable execution proofs, turning the fable of costless bot swarms into an economic impossibility. Each node must stake a cryptographic relic minted via sequential zero-knowledge hardware attestations, displayed on the violet verification spectrum. Identity registration enforces a superlinear staking curve where deploying N sybil agents incurs an exponential computational and capital cost of O(2^N).
